G01.notes: Symmetry tests, internal/developmental evidence and limited inference map to three original written explanations and retained classifications. Navigation alone does not satisfy completion.

G02.notes: Five selected examples add distinct symmetry/tissue/cavity contrasts. Two perpendicular tests compare planes, not replicate animals; probes distinguish lumen versus outside-gut tissue. No repeated preparation or default triple trials.

G03.notes: Read OpenStax 27.2/28.1/28.2/28.3 and Michigan ADW Nematoda. Verified selected whole-body symmetry, supplied tissue origins and the mesoderm boundary distinguishing acoelomate/pseudocoelomate/coelomate. Sponge water spaces and polyp gut are not mislabeled coeloms.

G04.notes: Idealized selected views, incomplete two-plane evidence, false colors/enlarged sections, supplied development records, omitted organs/species/life stages and lack of phylogenetic ranking stated. No direct microscopy, embryo or dissection claim.

G05.notes: Students rotate reflected geometry, test planes, place a section lens and probe anatomical regions before classifying. Actual actions/interpretations are retained, not merely animation navigation.
